title: Crash when adding items to option button
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 27.20.100.9664) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1165G7 @ 2.80GHz (8 threads) - 39.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

I was just setting up an `OptionButton`'s items and Godot crashed randomly out of nowhere on me. I do use a screen reader so I don't know if this was an accesskit bug (the output would suggest it is) so this may not be the appropriate forum for such reports, but I thought I would report it here just in case. I reloaded the project and it has (yet) to reoccur. For all I know this bug may have already been fixed.

### Steps to reproduce

Honestly, I'm not even sure how to reproduce this reliably, but I'll just post what I did.

1. Create a new project or open an existing one. I opened an existing one with a window as the scene root, VBoxContainer as a subnode, and inside that a bunch of widgets.
2. Add an `OptionButton` and start configuring it's items (in the inspector).
3. If you configure more than the number that fit on a page (I think the number is 5?), you'll suffer a prior bug I've already reported where you get sucked into an editor node you need NVDA object navigator to get out of. The node has a name like `@EditorNode139392` or something.
4. Go back to the inspector and try adding items. The bug may trigger at this point, or it might not; it triggered for me after I added approximately 6-7 items.

I wish I could provide more reliable reproduceability instructions, but I'm not even really sure how I triggered it in the first place.
